post.description: Authenticate user with email and password. Generates JWT token.

message.example: Access denied. Only Purchase Executive allowed.

post.description: Invalidate the current JWT token and end the session.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's profile data including image URL.

post.description: Update authenticated user's profile details and optional profile image.

password.description: New password if you want to change it

password_old.description: Current password hash to maintain if new password is not provided

get.description: Returns summary statistics and recent orders for the authenticated purchase executive.
Returns a paginated list of Purchase Orders belonging to the authenticated user. Supports filtering by status and date range.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Universal search (po_number, date, amount, supplier, agent)

parameters.name: po_date_range
parameters.description: Filter by date range (format: d-m-Y to d-m-Y)

get.description: Returns full information for a specific Purchase Order including line items and attachment URLs.

post.description: Updates the status of a specific Purchase Order. Status updates cannot go backwards (e.g., from Dispatched back to Approved).

get.summary: Get Initial Data for Creating PO
get.description: Generates the next PO number and fetches lists of active agents, suppliers, and store types.

get.summary: Get Item Details Metadata for PO
get.description: Fetches metadata needed for adding an item to a Purchase Order. Filters raw materials if store_category_id is provided.

parameters.name: store_category_id
parameters.description: Optional ID to filter raw materials by category

get.summary: Get Additional Information Metadata for PO
get.description: Fetches current status options, default payment terms, and attachment constraints.

get.summary: Get Tax Summary Metadata for PO
get.description: Fetches default tax percentages (CGST, SGST, IGST) from system settings.

post.description: Creates a new Purchase Order with multiple items and optional attachments. Automatically sets purchase_executive_id.
